services.title: Auto detailing
services.body: Vehicles are washed and detailed inside and out, not just rinsed.

reviews_h2: Straight from the people who called us

reviews.author: Jessica S
reviews.text: I can’t get a response from the number listed despite three calls in a week. I’ve been a faithful customer for years. I visited on Sunday Jan. 4 but the machine I used to vacuum didn’t have any suction. Switched machines but the debit card reader didn’t work. I got change and this second machine ate my quarters. I would like a response and refund please

reviews.author: Jeff Stone
reviews.text: This is the most neglected and terrible car wash I’ve ever been to. It didn’t used to be, but it’s like it’s been left to rot. Nothing works and trash is littered everywhere, and if you find a bay open, be aware it will either take your coins, the wand won’t work or the selection dials are totally incorrect. Do NOT waste your money here.

reviews.author: CW Paolucci
reviews.text: Do not bother attempting to wash your car here. Basically all of the features are either nonfunctional or faulty. Ended up wasting $18 to get rained on by water from the ceiling, covered in soap from the broken brush, and my car looked no better when I was done. Plus no response from the owner when I called. Save your time and money and go elsewhere.

reviews.author: Elliott Marks
reviews.text: This carwash was my go to place to clean my cars. It is now completely run down. Most of the stalls are closed and the couple that are open have no pressure. I was recently there. Swiped my card, the timer started but no water. I moved to a different stall and again swiped my card and water gushed out from the assembly at the top, getting me soaking wet. I hate having to submit this review, but at his point customers are being ripped off. This place needs to be shut down!

reviews.author: Ted Dorsi
reviews.text: If I could give this place a ZERO STAR rating I certainly would. Ownership has neglected this place to the point that many of the bays are closed due to broken or malfunctioning equipment. I lost $3.00 there today after swiping my card and selecting “HIGH PRESSURE SOAP” only to squeeze the trigger and there was no pressure and no soap. Same with RINSE. The foaming brush did work but I wonder how one would rinse the soap off with no water pressure. What a ripoff! I wish someone with a lick of business acumen and some industry experience would purchase this business from the current owner. With the proper upgrades and renovations this could be a very profitable business because there is a need for a car wash on the North end of town. To the business owner if you are reading this “SELL THIS BUSINESS TO SOMEONE WHO KNOWS WHAT THEY ARE DOING!”

reviews.author: Michael Moore
reviews.text: Attempted to go through the automated car wash but after paying it malfunctioned and my wash wouldn’t initiate. Tried hitting the “help” button but it did nothing. Called the phone number and left a message hoping for a refund but no one ever called back.

reviews.author: Dan Little
reviews.text: Machine took my money but sprayer only sprayed soap, no water. Other two bays wouldn't accept card. Waste of time and money trying to wash my car.

reviews.author: Jewel Walker
reviews.text: This place is TRASH you literally could not even pay me to take my vehicles here. Takes your money, quarters get stuck and the water just pours out from the top that’s it. Never again will I stop here. Should petition to have it shut down.

reviews.author: Jeannine Whitfield
reviews.text: Put money in and no water ever came out. Folks in other stall pressure was so low he couldn’t wash the soap off of his vehicle. He told us over half of the equipment wasn’t working. Just wanted to rinse vehicle but wasn’t able. First stall pulled into had tape across machine. Another was full of trash someone left. Left message on the number website has listed but the message you receive doesn’t say Southern Pride. So who really knows if they got our call. Disappointing to see how much it has gone down.

reviews.author: mark miller
reviews.text: DO NOT COME HERE FOR A CARWASH!! REPEAT DO NOT COME TO THIS DUMP!! Change machine took a 5 dollar bill, then the brush line is squirting out of the line. Put 12 dollars in the bay and get no pressure on the rinse nozzle. I used to love this place back in the day. Now it is a total RIP OFF!!

reviews.author: Family First
reviews.text: Use to be great car wash but this new owner is horrible. Nothing ever works and always taking money have lost $40 in past 3 months which the lying owner claim he would reimburse. Don’t go here unless you’re okay with wasting your money this place is poorly maintained, also the guy that does a so called job of maintaining it said that he hasn’t been paid by the owner in over a month himself, this guy needs to just sell this car wash he’s sorry

reviews.author: Taylor Jones
reviews.text: The machines literally don't work. If you try to use one of the stalls it dumps water on your head. Not exactly ideal. This should probably be reported to the state so that they can shut this place down

reviews.author: Jonathan Runyambo
reviews.text: Great Car wash! My father has been coming here for years now and loves it. I recently went and had a great experience, there was a minor issue. Where my card got charged extra but Bryan was responsive and helped me resolve it! Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Justin Baker
reviews.text: This new owner should shut this place down or sell it. He clearly does not care about customers, he wont return calls or messages. Tried 2 different bays to wash my van, and it just ate my money. Watched someone else try and wash their car and it ate their money too. The new owner has run this place into the ground!!

reviews.author: Scott Y
reviews.text: Nice enough car wash, but I did have a bad experience. Was there washing a car around 0630 last weekend. Get halfway through, and the lights go out! I called the phone number listed on Google, and there was no return call. I waited a few days before leaving a negative review, hoping they would call me and make it right. Had to finish in the dark so of course had missed spots.

reviews.author: Scott Carbonara
reviews.text: Garbage. Either the dials don't mark the products correctly, or more than half of the products are out of detergent. What should have been soap came out clear. The foaming brush had no foam. The spot-free feature lathered my car more than any of the others. Avoid this place. I spent a fortune getting all the remnants of miscellaneous sprays off my car.

reviews.author: Michelle Mosberger
reviews.text: I go here once in a while because I can clean my car well and fairly quickly. I haven’t been in a while but decided to stop by yesterday. I didn’t know the hoses were disconnected until I turned the dial to pre soak and the soap and water came from the ceiling onto my car and onto me. I had to come home and wash it after paying there. Ridiculous! I walked around and couldn’t find anybody to tell. The other stalls had cones in front blockage them. I looked up, and hoses were disconnected on those too. I’m not sure why this stall open. I tried calling the number listed on Google and left a message, and nobody has called back. Sadly, I’ll end up disputing the charge through my bank. The maintenance there is not great. If something is not usable, please don’t leave the stall open. It looked like the hoses were knowingly disconnected but someone failed to block the entrance.

reviews.author: Todd Dickinson
reviews.text: Does not work x 2 stalls. Took my credit card 2x and 12 Quarters. Then touchless failed to even rinse hood. Come on. U owe me $15. Todd Dickinson

reviews.author: Samantha Jackson
reviews.text: Half the machines don’t work or only work part way. Ended up having to pay for the auto wash just to get all the bug wash off that spit out while I was trying to rinse. This place needs a real remodel, not just new hoses and guns/brushes that don’t work.

reviews.author: Mary Cooper
reviews.text: Car wash doesn’t work properly. The price increased and the pressure was cut less thank have. Terrible place to wash your car. It needs an overhaul.

reviews.author: Aaron Belz
reviews.text: UPDATED. I've always appreciate how clean and well-maintained this self-wash facility is... the sign says your credit card will be charged $6, and the bill showed up on my visa as $10. But, as suggested in the owner's response below, it was just a holding fee for a few days. The final charge was $6. Sorry, Thomas- five stars now!

reviews.author: Ethan Friends
reviews.text: Pumps don’t work. Half the lanes are broken. Swiped cars no water. Complete waste of time. Go somewhere else. I’m calling my card to dispute that charge

reviews.author: steven storch
reviews.text: Waste of money, filthy overflowing garbage cans, broken equipment and no response or reply to phone or email requesting refund. Please go to the other wash closer to 40.

reviews.author: CHARLY BOY
reviews.text: The worst place in my whole life washing my car. All spots with broken brushes and machines not working. No pressure on hoses. Maybe the automatic can be used.

reviews.author: Matthew Brigdon
reviews.text: I really like this car wash when stuff works. Bay number 8 took 3.00 dollars from me this morning. The machine cut on and when I rotated the knob it cut off and started scrolling the welcome message again. Had to move to a different bay.

reviews.author: Jeff Creel
reviews.text: Absolute scam......used credit card, wash never started - moved to another bay, used card again, wash started but water was barely coming out , tried to switch to the brush, didn't work, tried to switch to rinse and soap kept coming out instead, and other choices didn't work on the dial- I finally gave up and left with soap all over my truck - half the bays were non functional and the wash was pitiful - no pride in Southern pride - absolutely would not recommend and will let everyone know how poor it is taken care of and run

reviews.author: Michael Snipes
reviews.text: Hardest working carwash owner in Orange County NC. They always speak or wave if I see them. It’s always clean and in working order. Incredible customer service if you have any problems. Easy to get in and out. Auto wash and the bays are always in top shape!

reviews.author: Susan
reviews.text: Wors car wash ever. A waste of money. I tried two different lanes and it only took my money and didn't work at all.

reviews.author: sirk selwob
reviews.text: Wasted my money. The dial is wrong, so you have to "play" with it to get it to work while your time is clicking away. Foam brush doesn't work. It looks way worse now than it did when I pulled it in the bay. Never again.

reviews.author: Angel Garcia
reviews.text: No soap or pressure and water was Luke warm. Had to use another lane to rinse my car off. Complete rip off!

reviews.author: Ricky Phillips
reviews.text: The wash station was clean, no trash. The pressure on the wand was strong,I was satisfied with my wash on my Toyota 4 runner.

reviews.author: Curry Hall
reviews.text: Best spot in town to get your car washed. The auto wash always does a good job. I also like to do the manual wash as well.

reviews.author: Paula McKinley
reviews.text: Always clean. Some of the vacuums and wash bays have card swipe option. One touchless bay option. The vacuums always work so it's my go to.

reviews.author: Silas Talbert
reviews.text: This place is the place to go when you wanna wash your car. I wash my car here anytime I have a chance, also there automatic car wash makes my car shine like it just came off the showroom floor!

reviews.author: Steven Navarra
reviews.text: Great facility. Had an issue and the owners responded promptly to take care of it. The best vacuums in town!

reviews.author: C Janssen
reviews.text: Southern pride sounds about rite. They are so layed back here that they can't keep there products full There's never any brightener or wheel cleaner

reviews.author: Billy Austin
reviews.text: The equipment is always in good condition. The place is clean and well maintained and the location is convenient for me.

reviews.author: Jeffrey Howard
reviews.text: Tried to wash my car in two bays. First one the cc machine didn’t work. No biggie. Second bay took my money, but the hoses in the ceiling for high pressure soap and rinse were broken. Low pressure and the foam brush didn’t work at all. Left a voicemail and text with the number on the door, got a text back saying he would make it right…crickets since then. Called and texted again, nada. Need to file a chargeback with my cc company. This place used to be fantastic, but has evidently been subject to deferred maintenance and lack of upkeep. Cannot recommend.
